name: FurstDate
source:
FurstDate is a furry dating simulator with five datable characters, each with their own unique personality. Find the girl of your dreams, ask for a date and have some fun!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
FurstDate是一款毛茸茸的约会模拟器，有五个可约会的角色，每个角色都有自己独特的个性。找到你梦想中的女孩，提出约会并享受乐趣！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1809740/]Steam[/url]]
